title: Streaming LRAT Certificates into Lean Theorems
abstract: arXiv:2607.00815v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: If the certificate produced by a SAT solver is checked by a verified checker, we get a verdict which convinces. But this verdict cannot be named, reused as a lemma, or composed with other formal developments. We propose the tool lrat-catcher, which turns a certificate into a Lean theorem. It checks the certificate as a stream while the solver is still running. Hence the certificate is not required to be saved to a file. Additionally, our tool makes Lean core's verified LRAT checker resumable so that its state can be serialized. We prove that checking divided at such a state still properly refutes the original formula. We propose two import modes. The stream mode reads the certificate from a pipe in blocks and checks it on the fly in memory. The file mode imports a stored certificate in chunks. translated_title: 将LRAT证书流式转换为Lean定理
translated_abstract: 如果SAT求解器产生的证书由经过验证的检查器进行检查，我们会得到一个令人信服的判定结论。但这个判定无法被命名、无法作为引理被重用，也无法与其他形式化研究成果组合使用。我们提出了工具lrat-catcher，它可以将证书转换为Lean定理。该工具在求解器仍在运行时就以流的方式检查证书，因此证书无需保存到文件中。此外，我们的工具使Lean核心库中经过验证的LRAT检查器变得可恢复，使其状态可以被序列化。我们证明了在这种状态下分割进行的检查仍然能够正确地反驳原始公式。我们提出了两种导入模式：流模式从管道中以数据块为单位读取证书并在内存中即时检查；文件模式以数据块为单位导入已存储的证书，如果被中断，它只重新检查尚未完成的块。流模式的可靠性定理保证了即使证书被扰乱（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出lrat-catcher工具，可在SAT求解器运行时以流方式检查LRAT证书并将其转化为可命名、可重用、可组合的Lean定理。
en_tdlr: We propose lrat-catcher, a tool that checks SAT solver LRAT certificates as a stream while the solver is still running and converts them into nameable, reusable, and composable Lean theorems.
